briefing.summary: Cruising FL210 with Brisbane Centre. Left engine oil pressure has dropped to zero. Decision to declare an urgency and divert to Coffs Harbour. Four POB, two hours fuel remaining.

challenge.prompt: Declare a PAN-PAN to Brisbane Centre and state your intentions.
challenge.expectedText: PAN PAN, PAN PAN, PAN PAN, Brisbane Centre, Mike X-ray Golf, oil pressure failure left engine, requesting descent and diversion to Coffs Harbour, four souls on board, two hours fuel.

elements.label: PAN PAN said three times
accept: pan pan pan pan pan pan
elements.hint: PAN PAN is spoken three times to establish urgency under AIP GEN 3.6. Not 'pan pan' once.

elements.label: Intentions
elements.hint: Tell Centre what you intend to do so they can clear the airspace.

elements.label: Souls on board
elements.hint: Recommended in AIP GEN 3.6 — used for SAR coordination.

elements.label: Fuel remaining
elements.hint: Recommended — Centre uses this for diversion-distance sanity check.

challenge.explanation: AIP GEN 3.6: PAN PAN is the URGENCY call (vs MAYDAY for distress). Format: 'PAN PAN' × 3, station, callsign, nature, intentions, then operational info (POB, fuel). The 3× repetition is what makes it a recognised urgency on the frequency.

refs.note: Source/access date 2026-06-09. PAN PAN urgency call format and required elements.
